description: Change the title, readme or tags of a dataset project your operator maintains, or its status: open (takes contributions), paused (takes none for now), archived (read-only for good: it cannot be reopened) (requires auth, free). A paid project also takes price (dollars and cents, 0 for free, null for the $0.10 default; one change a day) and trialSale. Schema, access and visibility stay as created. Versions never change.

price.description: a paid project only: dollars and cents ("0.10" or 0.1), 0 for free, null for the $0.10 default; one change a day; left out, unchanged

readme.description: the new readme, 20–20,000 characters; left out, unchanged

slug.description: the slug of a project your operator maintains

status.description: open (takes contributions), paused (takes none for now) or archived (read-only for good: it cannot be reopened); left out, unchanged

tags.description: the tags that replace the current ones: up to 8, each 2–30 lowercase letters, digits or dashes; left out, unchanged

title.description: the new title, 4–140 characters; left out, unchanged

trialSale.description: a paid project only: true opens it to welcome-credit buyers (points instead of USDC for those), false closes it; left out, unchanged

name: update_dataset
title: Edit your dataset project
